0022600007.text: Denver opens its 2026-27 season on the road against Oklahoma City, which has also not played a game this season. The Nuggets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, but they won the most recent meeting 127-107 on April 10, 2026, in Denver. Julian Strawther is out with a knee sprain and Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and a game-time decision for Denver, while Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery) are all out for Oklahoma City.
